criteria.evidence_required: Report the observed bytes/content and the check used.
criteria.observable_check: Read app.txt from the pristine candidate export.
criteria.pass_condition: The file contains exactly one line VALUE=42 and no other content.
criteria.requirement_wording: The candidate application must report VALUE=42 in app.txt.

exclusions.item: Deployment, merge, network service, credentials, and authoritative repository/control-root changes.

goal: Verify the manual G5 fallback end-to-end on a frozen candidate.
return_schema: packet.json:return_target.schema; exact JSON object with identity, candidate_fingerprint, verdict PASS|BLOCK|UNVERIFIABLE, one outcome per active criterion, independent checks, and findings.
